## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new setter should normalize keys before storing them because mixed-case writes cannot be retrieved.

## Changes
The pull request adds `Cache.set`, raises the default TTL from 60 to 300 seconds, and adds round-trip and expiry tests.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — Normalize keys when writing cache entries — Calling `set("Alpha", 1)` followed by `get("Alpha")` returns `None`: the setter stores the original key, while the getter always lowercases it. The round-trip test only writes a lowercase key. — Callers writing mixed-case keys lose access to cached values and can create duplicate entries instead of replacing existing values.
